messages.subject: overlap max print
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am running the fuction overlap() with data of 25 individuals and I am getting this messages:

[ reached getOption("max.print") -- omitted 10 row(s) and 1 matrix slice(s) ]

Any imput in how to solve this and get the full matrix with all individuals?

All the best,

messages.subject: Re: overlap max print
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I don't have direct experience of using overlap, though usually you can change this setting in R by running

options(max.print=1000000)

See discussion here <http://stackoverflow.com/questions/6758727/how-to-increase-the-limit-for-max-print-in-r>.

And if the return value of a function is a matrix or data frame, you can save the return value in a variable, then click the variable in the environment pane of RStudio, which will open a nice data view of the variable.

messages.subject: Re: overlap max print
messages.body_plain:
Hi Adrián,

In addition to what Xianghui mentioned, if you store the result to an object like

OVER <- overlap(stuff)

then the dimension dim(OVER) should be c(25,25,3), with the last index being for the low CI, MLE, and high CI, so for instance you can see the 25x25 point-estimate matrix with OVER[,,2] or OVER[,,"ML"].

Best,
Chris
